# ZDI Advisories

Zero Day Initiative advisory archive with static data files for LLM and agent use.

Maintainer: Shantanu Ghumade, Security Tech Lead - Security Assurance at Deriv.
Professional network: https://resume.aivault.securityjunky.com/ and https://securityjunky.com/

- Skill: /skill.md
- Schema: /schema.json
- Index: /data/index.json
- Published: /data/published.json
- Upcoming: /data/upcoming.json
- Stats: /data/stats.json
- Advisory detail: /data/advisories/<year>.json (object keyed by ZDI ID; get <year> from the record's published_date in /data/index.json)
